_note: HYBRID-1109 (OD-1109-HYBRID, owner 2026-11-09: "Yes, hybrid search"). Stored-passage retrieval adds embedding similarity to word matching. FLAG OFF by default: enabled=false => no embedding call, no vector load, no new candidate or trace key; retrieval and admission are byte-identical to before. When true it also needs the chunk-taxonomy job to have stored vectors (vera_vjay.tax_chunk_vectors, migration 024) for the served chunks, and a usable embedder (config/chunk_taxo.json: same Cloudflare account, token and model as the taxonomy job). Each question is embedded once (one HTTPS call, timeout_s, one attempt); any failure, quota or budget stop falls back to word-only search and is traced as a code (never the question text). Design and measurements: vera/hybrid_retrieval.py docstring.
_rrf_k_note: Reciprocal rank fusion constant for both fusions (BM25 + vector candidates in vera.dar_corpus.retrieve; lexical + vector admission order in vera.fulldoc_admission). 60 is the standard RRF constant and equals config/domain_routing.json rrf_k; rank-only, so it compares no scores across signals. Not a decision threshold.
_vector_k_note: Size of the vector candidate list; null = the BM25 branch size (config/domain_routing.json corpus.branch_k, 20).
_chunks_per_partition_note: Stored vectors are per stored partition (evidence_spans row, about 4000 characters); retrieval chunks are 400 characters. The vector list takes at most this many chunks from one partition (its best BM25 chunks first, then by position), so the list spans several partitions. Structural prior, not a decision threshold.
_stem_floor_sim_note: Vector stem-floor rule (vera.fulldoc_admission): a candidate whose partition cosine similarity to the question is >= stem_floor_sim passes the two lexical floors (min_relevance and the matched-stem floor) provided it still matches at least stem_floor_min_hits question content stems; every other admission rule (licence, attribution, body section, topic anchor, pointer filter, one-stem rule, question coverage, caps) is unchanged. null = the rule is OFF. PENDING CAL: no real vectors exist yet (no network for agents). Calibrate on the first real tax_chunk_vectors rows: the cosine spread of bge-m3 question-vs-partition similarity for labelled on-topic and off-topic partitions over the scope_set questions; set the value below the lowest on-topic and above the off-topic bulk, record the spread here, and only then set a number (records/memory/feedback_threshold_calibration_rule.md).
_cooldown_note: After an embedding error or timeout no question is embedded for cooldown_s (word-only search meanwhile), so a Cloudflare outage adds at most one timeout per cooldown window. A quota or budget stop waits until 00:00 UTC.
_query_cache_note: Question vectors are cached in process memory only, keyed by the sha256 of the question text (never the text), so the base and acquired corpora and repeat retrievals of one question share one embedding call.
_max_index_note: Refuses to build a vector index larger than this (float32 rows x dim x 4 bytes). Measured offline (synthetic, 5,500 x 1024): matrix 21.5 MB, resident +27.5 MB after build, peak +28.4 MB, chunk map +0.9 MB (work/HYBRID-1109/measurements.md, not in the repo). Not a decision threshold: a memory guard under the 512 MB service limit.

rerank._note: Stage 2 (orchestrator decision within OD-1109-HYBRID, 2026-11-09). OWN FLAG, default false; needs the stage-1 flag above too. After stage 1, the top_partitions stored partitions (RRF of the partition cosine order and the partition best-BM25 order) have their 400-character retrieval passages (at most max_passages, each cut to max_chars) embedded at ask time in ONE batched Cloudflare call (timeout_s, one attempt) and ranked by cosine to the question vector; that passage order joins the vector candidate list and is a third RRF input to the admission order. Passage vectors are cached in process memory per (sha256(text), model), LRU of cache_max entries; nothing is written to the database from the ask path. Budget: the estimated neurons (characters / 3 tokens x 1075 per million for bge-m3; 48 x 400 characters is about 6.9 neurons) must fit the ask-time share (config/chunk_taxo.json cloudflare.reserve_neurons, counted per UTC day in process memory together with the question embeddings); else, and on any error, quota or timeout, stage 2 falls back to the stage-1 list (traced as a code) and waits cooldown_s (quota or share: until 00:00 UTC). At the shipped share of 5000 (orchestrator decision 2026-11-09; the job keeps 3000) that is about 700 uncached re-ranks a day; cached passages cost nothing.
rerank._reserve_slots_note: The reserve_slots best passage-level matches are placed first in the candidate list (before the per-document cap), as the domain-branch fallback reservation does for word matching: without it a passage found only by stage 2 is outvoted by passages that appear in both word and partition lists. The vector stem-floor rule uses the passage cosine instead of the partition cosine for re-ranked passages.
rerank._cache_note: 2048 x 1024 float32 = 8 MB plus keys; measured in work/HYBRID-1109/measurements.md. top_partitions, max_passages and cache_max are structural and cost bounds set by the orchestrator, not decision thresholds.
